description: Generates an Italian Codice Fiscale from personal data (surname, first name, date of birth, sex, and municipality/foreign country of birth — or the Belfiore code directly). Returns the "base" code (the omocodia variant used in case of collision is assigned by the Agenzia delle Entrate). Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.

codice_belfiore.description: Cadastral/Belfiore code of the place of birth (precise alternative to comune).

comune.description: Municipality (or foreign country) of birth. Alternatively use codice_belfiore.

provincia.description: Province code (e.g. PI) to disambiguate municipalities with the same name.

name: generate_codice_fiscale
title: Generate Codice Fiscale
